name: U.S. Census Bureau — ACS data/API documentation
scope: Official method and release coverage for ACS tract/block-group demographics, income, housing, and population; no subject geography can be selected until location is privately geocoded.

name: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics — Los Angeles Area Economic Summary
scope: Official metro/county/city labor market summary. Geographic coverage varies by measure; not a site-level forecast.

name: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis — Los Angeles County GDP and personal income, 2024
scope: Official county aggregate; latest county reference year available on access date (2025 county estimates scheduled for 2026-12-02). Not neighborhood income or household purchasing power.

name: California Department of Education — DataQuest
scope: Official school/district/county data reports. A specific attendance area requires site location and district confirmation.

name: City of Los Angeles Planning — ZIMAS
scope: Official city parcel/zoning/planning map; only applies if the site is within Los Angeles City boundaries, and parcel-level review is still needed.

name: Los Angeles County Assessor — Real Property Assessment
scope: Official county guidance on assessed value, Proposition 13, reassessment on change in ownership/new construction; parcel-level assessment is not provided here.

name: FEMA — National Flood Hazard Layer
scope: Official effective flood hazard data viewers and limitations; no parcel determination without a location and map review.

name: CAL FIRE — Fire Hazard Severity Zone maps
scope: Official Office of the State Fire Marshal FHSZ page. It distinguishes hazard from risk, links effective SRA maps, a 2026 SRA comment process, and 2025 LRA rollout material; confirm parcel-specific local adoption and map status.

name: California Geological Survey — Earthquake Zones of Required Investigation
scope: Official map viewer for fault rupture, liquefaction, and seismic landslide regulatory zones; no parcel result without location.

name: SEC EDGAR — Jack in the Box Inc. FY2025 Form 10-K
scope: Issuer-level filing only. It does not disclose this unidentified franchisee's credit, this site's sales, lease terms, or renewal intent.

name: Internal Revenue Service — 2026 Instructions for Form 8824
scope: Official federal tax guidance for reporting like-kind exchanges; does not establish eligibility or tax outcome for a particular owner.

name: Los Angeles County Registrar-Recorder — Documentary Transfer Tax
scope: Official county/city documentary transfer tax guidance. Actual rates depend on the property's jurisdiction and closing date.

name: City of Los Angeles Office of Finance — Measure ULA FAQ
scope: Official Los Angeles City transfer tax thresholds/rates and applicability; threshold schedules may change and City boundaries must be verified.

name: U.S. Census Bureau — 2024 ACS 5-year API dataset reference
scope: Official catalog for the 2024 ACS five-year dataset and available geographies/variables.
